summary: Phuket language school offering an education visa package with English, Thai, French and Chinese lessons (page in Russian).

facts.label: Education visa
facts.value: Offers a student (education) visa for staying long in Thailand
facts.quote: Студенческая виза — самый простой способ остаться в Таиланде надолго

facts.label: One-year visa package
facts.value: 59,000 baht total per person for one year

facts.label: School enrolment part
facts.value: 32,000 baht for enrolment in the school

facts.label: Certificate
facts.value: Certificate licensed by the Ministry of Education

facts.label: Languages
facts.quote: Обучение сразу 4 языкам: английский, тайский, французский, китайский

facts.label: Visa duration
facts.value: Student visa can be kept for up to 5 years
facts.quote: Оставаться на студенческой визе можно до 5 лет.
